text:
ana: heads up - release pipeline failed on `release/js-sdk` during publish step after typegen regen. error:
```
ERR! EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL: Unsupported protocol "git+https:"
Failed to fetch from git+https://git.internal/redwood/some-external-dep.git
```
kevin: hmm that's from the package-lock update. did typegen bump a dependency to be a git url?
marta: yep, our codegen template for package.json includes "example-dep": "git+https://git.internal/redwood/some-external-dep.git#v1.3.0" when `x-vendor-extension: true` is present. the CI runner doesn't have access to internal git host, so publish fails.
chris: options: switch to tarball url for publish, vendor the dep in the package, or update CI to have git credentials. for hosted registry we typically avoid git+ URLs.
nana: (typo - ana) let's avoid leaking internal git urls. i'll update the generator template to use semver ranges and the distrib package on npm when possible. for now i'll revert the package-lock change and re-run regen with a template fix.
ci-bot: [build 9310] FAILURE on release/js-sdk - publish failed. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9310 :x:
kevin: also add a lint step to catch git+ URL deps in package.json before publish. opened PR #447 to change template and add linter rule.
chris: good call. addition: add a CI secret that allows read-only fetch from git.internal only for release-engineering jobs (short-lived). we'll avoid general runners having that credential.
nana: PR #447 merged. restarted publish pipeline.
ci-bot: [build 9315] SUCCESS - publish step completed. :white_check_mark:
